newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Third party shows interest in CEPA stake.
newsitem.headline: Third party shows interest in CEPA stake.

text.p: Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA) said on Thursday a third party has approached it about a possible acquisition of a controlling interest in the company.
It said no offer or formal proposal had been received from the third party.

"The board wishes to advise that...it has received an approach from one third party for the possible acquisition of a controlling interest in CEPA. However, the board would like to emphasise that no offer or formal proposal has been received from this independent third party," CEPA said in a statement.
"A further announcement will be issued by CEPA should any firm offer or proposal be made," it added.
CEPA parent Hopewell Holdings Ltd announced on October 10 that it had agreed to sell a major portion of its 60.4 percent interest in CEPA to Southern Electric International, a unit of Southern Co.
CEPA shares were up HK$0.20 at HK$18.05 and Hopewell shares were unchanged at HK$5.45.
